title: Installation.
officialText:
Direct-fired industrial air heaters shall be permitted to be installed in accordance with their listing and the
manufacturer’s instructions. Direct-fired industrial air heaters shall be installed only in industrial or commercial occupancies. Direct-
fired industrial air heaters shall be permitted to provide fresh air ventilation.
